items.source:
The calling mechanism will take care of adding and removing configured prefixes and
transforming keys and values into something that Neo4j can understand.
items.translation: 调用机制将负责添加和移除已配置的命名空间前缀，并将键和值转换为 Neo4j 能够理解的格式。

items.source: Composes the object back from the map.
items.translation: 根据映射将对象重新构建。

items.source: Decomposes an object into a map.

Decomposes an object into a map. A conversion service is provided in case
delegation is needed.
items.translation: 将对象分解为 Map。如果需要委派，则提供转换服务。

items.source:
Composes the object back from the map. The map contains the raw driver values, as
SDN cannot know how you want to handle them. Therefore, the conversion service to
convert driver values is provided.
items.translation: 从映射中还原对象。该映射包含原始驱动值，因为 SDN 无法知晓您希望如何处理这些值。因此，提供了用于转换驱动值的转换服务。

items.source: K - the type of the keys (Only Strings and Enums are supported).
items.translation: K - 键的类型（仅支持字符串和枚举）。

items.source: P - the type of the property.
neo4jConversionService - the conversion service to delegate to if necessary
items.translation: neo4jConversionService - 必要时委托的转换服务

items.source: neo4jConversionService - the conversion service in case you want to delegate the work for some values in the map
items.translation: neo4jConversionService - 转换服务，如果您希望将地图中某些值的处理工作委托给它。

items.source:
You need to provide an implementation of this interface in case you want to store a
property of an entity as separate properties on a node. The entity needs to be
decomposed into a map and composed from a map for that purpose.
items.translation: 如果您希望将实体的属性作为节点的独立属性进行存储，则需要实现此接口。为此，必须将该实体分解为映射（map），并从映射中将其组合起来。
